goal.request: Add detailed observable photo-composition semantics and candidate data, then independently test three randomized complex concepts with the supplied adult-appearance reference.

evidence.claim: The supplied file visibly depicts an adult-presenting portrait with long dark wavy hair; its permitted role in this experiment is observable adult appearance only.
Composition labels were translated into observable spatial relations, boundaries, false substitutes, and pixel-review gates with bounded source claims.
The baseline revision did not contain the twelve new composition visual-obligation profiles or their candidate IDs.

evidence.claim: Dictionary metadata, visual-profile index, semantic index, dedicated exact/negative/embedding tests, authorial-core v6, prepack isolation, scene-expression audit, contradiction, generalization, rule holdout, and retrieval holdout checks passed. The six failures in the broad visual-obligation suite reproduce on baseline HEAD around the unrelated exact term nurse.

evidence.claim: Arm 01 v6 candidate pack, composed prompt, and runtime request passed their structural audits with all twelve requested hard gates represented.
Arm 02 v6 candidate pack, composed prompt, and runtime request passed their structural audits with all twelve requested hard gates represented.
Arm 03 v6 candidate pack, composed prompt, and runtime request passed their structural audits with all twelve requested hard gates represented.
Each independent arm used its frozen request and authorial core, the supplied reference hash, no cross-arm inputs, and exactly one successful built-in image generation call with no retry or fallback.
Arm 01 passed 11 of 12 hard gates; true frame center landed on a plain torso/apron region rather than the identity- or action-bearing face, hands, or map.
Arm 02 passed all 12 hard gates for thirds placement, look/motion room, and a single focal exception in a repeated lamp pattern.
Arm 03 passed 9 of 12 hard gates; the cropped lower body and camera-facing gaze did not establish the declared rightward travel vector or prove that right-side space was ahead.

perceptual_contract.primary_success_condition: Every selected composition term must become a first-read observable spatial relation in the delivered pixels, and every hard gate for an arm must pass because partial fulfillment is failure.

invariants.statement: A composition name or prompt mention cannot substitute for the required locations, boundaries, directions, relative weights, and false-substitute exclusions.
The supplied portrait is restricted to visible adult appearance cues and cannot support identity, same-person, biometric, or protected-trait claims.
Each arm must use independently frozen inputs, one image call, no retry, no fallback, and no cross-arm artifacts.

mismatches.source_state: The research distinguished observable relations and confusion boundaries for composition terms.
mismatches.render_state: The baseline package lacked the twelve corresponding full visual-obligation contracts and gates.

mismatches.source_state: An identity- or action-bearing anchor had to intersect the exact frame center.
mismatches.render_state: The exact center intersected a plain torso/apron area between the face and map-lifting action.

mismatches.source_state: A visible rightward subject vector had to make the larger right-side field read as space ahead.
mismatches.render_state: The body read paused and the gaze turned toward camera, leaving only an environmental bridge line rather than a subject vector.

hypotheses.statement: Composition concepts become testable when encoded as multiple observable component groups, literal evidence fields, render gates, and explicit false substitutes rather than aliases alone.
hypotheses.falsifier: Exact terms still fail to route hard, false substitutes activate them, or composed prompts omit required evidence.

hypotheses.statement: Even a structurally complete prompt may lose an exact center target or directional room relation when the generated pose, gaze, or crop contradicts the requested anchor.
hypotheses.falsifier: Independent complex renders consistently pass the exact-center and directional-vector gates across conflicting scenes and poses.

intervention.general_rule: Represent a composition term as an observable relation contract with four semantic components, literal prompt bindings, pixel gates, and reject-substitute boundaries; expose the same relation through a conservative candidate entry and conflicts.
intervention.generalization_basis: The contracts refer to measurable frame relations rather than the three test scenes, and they are exercised through exact, negative, embedding-only, prompt, and independent render checks.

decision.rationale: The package and prompt layers are complete, but strict pixel qualification passed only one of three independent arms and 32 of 36 hard gates. Center targeting and motion-room robustness therefore remain revision targets; user aesthetic judgment is still unscored.
